title: CoreUtils
description: CoreUtils is a fast, lightweight, and fully featured all-in-one plugin that provides home management, custom items, item editing, polished GUIs, essential admin commands, and multi-language support, giving server owners complete control without unnecessary
body:
## CoreUtils — Advanced Multi-Tool Plugin for Minecraft Servers
Everything you need in one plugin! From home management to item editing and player utilities — all elegantly designed, efficient, and fully configurable.
##
### Features
Home System
- Set, delete, and teleport to your custom homes
- Intuitive GUI interface
- Configurable max homes and teleport delay
- Auto-cancel if player moves during teleport

Item Editing (/itemedit)
- Edit item names and lore using & color codes or MiniMessage syntax
- Manage item flags (hide enchantments, attributes, unbreakable, etc.)
- Toggle flags on/off via user-friendly GUI

Custom Items (/customitem)
- Create and save custom items with unique properties
- Store items as YAML files for easy sharing and backup
- Commands: take, create, delete
- Full support for enchantments, lore, display names, and flags

Player Info (/about)
- Beautiful animated GUI showing player stats
- Displays: UUID, first join, play time, kills, deaths
- Clickable UUID for easy copying to clipboard

Admin Commands
- /heal — heal yourself or other players
- /gamemode — change game mode (0/1/2/3)
- /fly — toggle flight mode
- /god — toggle invincibility
- /vanish — hide/show players
- /wakeup — wake up AFK players with a loud Ghast scream! 😱
##
> Multi-Language Support: English & Polish
> 
> Add new languages easily via YAML files in Langs/
> 
> Full translation coverage: messages, GUIs, and titles
##
### Configuration & Control
- Disable any feature in config.yml
- Fine-grained permission control
- Reload config with /cu reload
- No external dependencies — runs standalone!
### Installation
- Download the latest version from Modrinth
- Place the .jar file into your server’s plugins/ folder
- Start your server
- Configure config.yml to your needs
- Enjoy a powerful, clean utility plugin!
